1.0.0.description: High-performance typed signal using a doubly-linked connection list and a coroutine thread pool. Supports Connect (with optional bound varargs), Once, Wait, Fire, DisconnectAll, Destroy, and Signal.wrap for bridging RBXScriptSignals.
